status.AWAITING_EVIDENCE: Waiting for the supplier's additional evidence, milestone on {{decision}}

impact.title: Impact on payment
impact.footnote: While the dispute is open, the milestone cannot be paid. Every step is recorded in the history.

decision.title: Your decision

ACCEPT_WAIVE_PENALTY.name: Accept, waive the penalty
ACCEPT_WAIVE_PENALTY.description: The milestone is re-evaluated and goes through two-person approval as usual.

KEEP_PENALTY.name: Keep the penalty
KEEP_PENALTY.description: The reason is sent back to the supplier. The dispute closes and the milestone is re-evaluated with the original amount.

REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE.name: Request more evidence
REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE.description: The supplier is notified and submits more documents. The dispute stays open.

note.label: Reason
note.required: Enter a reason for the decision.

decision.pendingPoint: Open question: only the buyer resolves disputes for now. Should this step need a third party or two-person approval?

outcome.ACCEPT_WAIVE_PENALTY: Accepted, penalty waived. The milestone is re-evaluated and moves on to approval.
outcome.KEEP_PENALTY: Penalty kept. The dispute is closed and the milestone is re-evaluated with the original amount.
outcome.REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE: The supplier was asked for more evidence. The dispute stays open.
